searchText: <MMJahanara> The general direction of the EIP makes perfect sense to me! Is it actively being considered for L1? The only part that seems a bit uncertain to me is the 10x factor. Why not 5x or 20x? Especially since the cost would vary for each proof system. A multi-dimensional fee market, which charges a proof fee per opcode proportional to the number of constraints it costs (or rows in the constraint table), would be more accommodating of different proof systems.
